subject: english
question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is "**Magnanemous**." [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The option which is incorrectly spelled is "**Magnanemous**."
 
• The correct spelling of "Magnanemous" is **Magnanimous**."
 
• **Magnanimous** means A person who has a good heart and mind.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let us know the meaning of other words.
 
• **Gullible** means A person who over-trusts anyone.
 
• **Dissimulation** means A person who doesn't share feelings or thoughts.
 
• **Indecisiveness** means A person who can't make decisions.
